name: Ki Insight (Ki)
body:
Your focused mind allows you to see the hidden patterns in reality.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation, Sense Motive 5 ranks

Benefit(s): As long as you have at least 1 point in your ki pool, you gain a +2 bonus to Sense Motive checks. In addition, as a swift or immediate action you can expend 1 point from your ki pool to gain a +2 insight bonus to a Will save or a +10 insight bonus to a Sense Motive check used to opposed a Bluff check.
